verdict.rationale: RELEASE-NOTES.md evidence shows frequent, detailed releases (worktree fixes, sdd-workspace changes, review-fix loop restructuring, new harness support for Devin/Hermes/Grok) demonstrating active maintenance, and community HN discussion shows real usage/feedback. However there is no evidence of issue triage (no issue tracker activity cited) or of accepted external community pull requests/contributions being merged. Missing for 10: evidence of issue triage process, evidence of accepted third-party PRs/contributions, and independent confirmation of contribution acceptance beyond release notes.
